verdict.rationale: Circle's docs name official SDKs. Wallets can be integrated via Web and Mobile SDKs for Android and iOS, and Bridge Kit is a lightweight SDK for CCTP-based USDC transfers in a few lines of code. The CLI docs also refer to the multiple SDKs it consolidates. Missing for 10: evidence of server-side language SDKs (e.g., Node/Python/Go), per-SDK depth (reference docs, versioning, coverage across Gateway/CPN/Contracts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
